clue.text: Relatively tasteless young bird heard

parts.note: a cheeper is a young bird, a chick that cheeps

explanation.surface: A cheap-looking fledgling whose call sounds a little vulgar.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheap can mean vulgar or lacking refinement, so the comparative fits 'relatively' lacking in good taste.

clue.text: Solicitous about university student supporting judge

parts.note: ca, short for circa, means about
a ref, short for referee, judges a game
L is a learner, as on British learner-driver plates

explanation.surface: A caring student backing a judge at college.
explanation.definitionFit: Solicitous means attentive and concerned, the same sense as being cautious and caring.

clue.text: Curiously I've no use mostly for showing covetousness

indicators.note: curiously means in an odd way, so these letters are rearranged
mostly means all but the last letter of use is kept

parts.note: the word use itself

explanation.surface: Strangely, a jealous person claims to have no purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: Envious means resentfully wanting what others have, which is covetousness.

clue.text: Exploiting others portrayed differently

indicators.note: differently means arranged another way, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A user of people is shown in a new light.
explanation.definitionFit: Predatory behaviour preys on weaker people for gain.

clue.text: Draws conclusions concerning adult offspring

parts.note: re means about or concerning
A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult
sons are male offspring

explanation.surface: Someone works things out about grown-up children.
explanation.definitionFit: To reason is to think logically and infer, arriving at a judgement.

clue.text: Survive till the final wicket?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to live or last longer than something
second meaning, read as two words: a batsman who stays in until the last wicket falls is ...

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a batsman who stays until the final wicket falls is the one out last, which split differently is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To outlast is to endure beyond something else, the plain sense of survive.

clue.text: Nothing at breakfast, maybe, but this?

definitions.text: Nothing at breakfast, maybe, but this?

parts.note: O is zero, nothing
breakfast is an example of a meal

explanation.surface: Asking whether porridge is the only thing for breakfast.
explanation.definitionFit: Oatmeal is ground oats, eaten as porridge, a classic morning food.

clue.text: Is worthless stuff turning up in trunks?

indicators.note: in a down answer turning up means read from bottom to top, so the letters go backwards

parts.note: rot is rubbish or nonsense

explanation.surface: Asking whether junk is appearing in luggage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trunks' suggests suitcases or swimwear, but here means human bodies minus head and limbs.
explanation.definitionFit: A torso is the human trunk; the plural is the Italian-style form.

clue.text: College life deemed a cakewalk, somewhat, on reflection

indicators.note: on reflection says the hidden letters are read backwards
somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Looking back, university days seemed easy.
explanation.definitionFit: Academe is the world of universities and scholarship, the academic environment.

clue.text: News channel pursuing bustle about revolutionary

indicators.note: pursuing means following behind, so this piece comes second

parts.note: to trot about is to bustle around busily
Sky News is a British television news channel

explanation.surface: A news channel chasing after a scrambling radical.
explanation.definitionFit: Leon Trotsky was a leader of the Russian Revolution of 1917.

clue.text: At sea, I arrive in coastal region

indicators.note: being at sea means confused, so these letters are muddled into a new order

explanation.surface: A traveller lands somewhere on a sunny Mediterranean shore.
explanation.definitionFit: The Riviera is the famous stretch of shoreline along southern France and northern Italy.

clue.text: Violent storm split a party

parts.note: torn means split or ripped
a do is an informal word for a party

explanation.surface: A wild storm breaks up a gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: A tornado is a rotating column of wind, one of the most destructive kinds of weather.

clue.text: Plants I'd lifted from US state

indicators.note: lifted from means taken away out of, so these letters are removed

parts.note: Florida is a US state
I'd gives the letters I and D

explanation.surface: Someone pinched some plants from Florida.
explanation.definitionFit: Flora is the collective term for the plant life of a region.

clue.text: Experts incorporating method in brief jokes

indicators.note: incorporating means taking in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a oner is an old slang word for an expert
a line is a method or course of action, as in a line of approach

explanation.surface: Specialists building technique into short gags.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-liner is a quip or gag delivered in a single short sentence.

clue.text: Broadcast belittles instructive examples

indicators.note: broadcast means spoken out over the air, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: lessens means reduces or belittles

explanation.surface: A programme goes out that runs people down, offering cautionary tales.
explanation.definitionFit: Lessons can be experiences or cases that teach something, warnings from which we learn.

clue.text: Crime racket oddly linking two US cities

indicators.note: linking means joining, so the letters sit between the two cities

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles and NY is New York

indicators.note: oddly picks the first, third and fifth letters of racket

explanation.surface: A criminal scam that spans two American cities.
explanation.definitionFit: Larceny is the legal term for theft, taking another's property unlawfully.

clue.text: One not in favour of Brexit entertaining disdain essentially for the rest

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, so one piece is held inside the other

parts.words: One not in favour of Brexit
parts.note: a Remainer voted for Britain to stay in the EU in the 2016 referendum

indicators.note: essentially means at the core, so only the central letter of disdain is taken

explanation.surface: A pro-EU voter treats Brexit with contempt for everyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: The remainder is what is left over, everything else.

clue.text: He could probably calculate composition of any salt properly presented

definitions.text: He could probably calculate composition of any salt properly presented

indicators.note: composition means putting together, so these letters are arranged afresh
properly presented means set out in the right order, confirming the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A chemist could work out what any salt is made of.
explanation.definitionFit: An analyst examines substances to determine their constituents, the job of a chemical tester.

clue.text: Trouble of small island accommodating large fellows

indicators.note: accommodating means housing, so the other letters go inside

parts.note: an ait is a small river island, especially on the Thames
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
men are fellows

explanation.surface: An islet's woes from housing big chaps.
explanation.definitionFit: An ailment is an illness or complaint, a bodily trouble.

clue.text: American, on reflection, providing entertainment

parts.note: musing means thinking things over, reflecting

explanation.surface: An American thinking back on what fun was had.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on reflection' looks like a reversal signal but is simply a synonym of musing.
explanation.definitionFit: Amusing means funny or diverting, giving people enjoyment.

clue.text: Greek character on trial is most stressed

indicators.note: in a down answer on means placed above, so this piece comes first

parts.note: tau is the Greek letter T
a test is a trial

explanation.surface: A Greek defendant under great strain during his hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Tautest is the superlative of taut, meaning pulled tight or under the most tension.

clue.text: Bane of start of nauseous vomiting

indicators.note: start of means only the opening letter of nauseous is used

parts.note: emesis is the medical word for vomiting

explanation.surface: Seasickness is the curse of anyone feeling queasy.
explanation.definitionFit: A nemesis is a person's downfall or persistent enemy, the thing that plagues them.

clue.text: Eternal loser, no flair ultimately limiting hard work and energy

indicators.note: limiting means bounding on each side, so the other letters go inside
ultimately means only the last letter of flair

parts.note: H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard
op, short for opus, is a work
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A born failure without talent barely manages effort and vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: A no-hoper is someone with no prospect of success, a perpetual failure.

clue.text: Replaces black gold — substance found just below the surface

definitions.text: substance found just below the surface

parts.note: subs means substitutes or replaces
black gold is a nickname for crude oil

explanation.surface: Swapping out oil for something shallow underground.
explanation.definitionFit: Subsoil is the layer of earth lying immediately beneath the topsoil.

clue.text: Smoothly devious involving a national emblem

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the other piece goes inside

parts.note: sly means devious or cunning
the leek is the national emblem of Wales

explanation.surface: A slick, crafty scheme around a country's symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleekly means in a glossy, polished, slick way.

clue.text: Violent hoodlum and thug regularly a blusterer

indicators.note: violent means wild and disturbed, so these letters are thrown into a new order
regularly picks every other letter of thug, here the second and fourth

explanation.surface: A brutal gangster and his heavy are all bluster.
explanation.definitionFit: A loudmouth is someone who talks noisily and boastfully, much like a braggart.

clue.text: Recurring phrase upset almost two-thirds of Ottomans

indicators.note: in a down answer upset means turned upside down, so the letters are read backwards
two-thirds of eight letters is just over five, and almost means falling short, so five are kept and the rest removed

explanation.surface: A slogan repeated by disgruntled Turks of old.
explanation.definitionFit: A motto is a short saying adopted as a guiding principle, often repeated.

clue.text: Deeply tinge limbs with hues, dropping restraints

explanation.surface: Colours seeping into arms and legs once bonds are removed.
explanation.definitionFit: To imbue is to saturate or dye something thoroughly, permeating it with colour.

clue.text: Record first heartless love letter

parts.note: EP is an extended-play record
1st, written with I for the digit one

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letters of the word are removed

parts.note: the word love itself

explanation.surface: A record of one's first love letter that had no feeling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' is written 1ST, with the digit read as the letter I. 'heartless' strips the middle OV from LOVE, leaving LE.

clue.text: Flat place of arrival in small field

parts.note: a pad is slang for a flat or home

explanation.surface: A level landing spot inside a little meadow.
explanation.definitionFit: A paddock is an enclosed patch of grass, often for horses.

clue.text: Tower in every detail penetrated by disastrous bug

parts.note: to a T means exactly, in every detail

indicators.note: disastrous suggests wrecked, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.walkthrough: 'Tower' reads as a tall building, but here it is something that tows.
explanation.definitionFit: A tugboat pulls ships into harbour, so it is literally one that tows.

clue.text: Ball game gathering characteristic of the countryside

parts.note: RU is short for rugby union
a rally is a mass gathering or meeting

explanation.surface: A rugby match draws a crowd in country fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Rurally means in a rustic way, in the manner of farms and villages.
